name: Kiro IDE (custom)
description: Mission-control IDE. Deep navy-black canvas, blue panel borders with outer glow, electric blue accent, cyan secondary, violet tertiary. Orbitron headings, Inter body, JetBrains Mono code. Chamfered top-left/bottom-right corners, faint blue grid and radial glow.
